1.mohsin_khan: Ha-Mim. [These letters are one of the miracles of the Quran, and none but Allah (Alone) knows their meanings].

2.pickthall: By the Scripture which maketh plain,
2.yusuf_ali: By the Book that makes things clear,-
2.shakir: I swear by the Book that makes things clear:
2.muhammad_sarwar: I swear by the illustrious Book.
2.mohsin_khan: By the manifest Book (that makes things clear, i.e. this Quran).

3.sahih_international: Indeed, We have made it an Arabic Qur'an that you might understand.
3.pickthall: Lo! We have appointed it a Lecture, in Arabic that haply ye may understand.
3.yusuf_ali: We have made it a Qur'an in Arabic, that ye may be able to understand (and learn wisdom).
3.shakir: Surely We have made it an Arabic Quran that you may understand.
3.muhammad_sarwar: We have made it an Arabic reading text so that perhaps you may understand.
3.mohsin_khan: We verily, have made it a Quran in Arabic, that you may be able to understand (its meanings and its admonitions).
3.arberry: behold, We have made it an Arabic Koran; haply you will understand;

4.sahih_international: And indeed it is, in the Mother of the Book with Us, exalted and full of wisdom.
4.pickthall: And Lo! in the Source of Decrees, which We possess, it is indeed sublime, decisive.
4.yusuf_ali: And verily, it is in the Mother of the Book, in Our Presence, high (in dignity), full of wisdom.
4.shakir: And surely it is in the original of the Book with Us, truly elevated, full of wisdom.
4.muhammad_sarwar: It (the Quran) exists in the original Book with Us which is certainly Most Exalted, full of wisdom and (beyond linguistic structures).
4.mohsin_khan: And Verily, it (this Quran) is in the Mother of the Book (i.e. Al-Lauh Al-Mahfuz), before Us, indeed Exalted, full of Wisdom.
4.arberry: and behold, it is in the Essence of the Book, with Us; sublime indeed, wise.

5.sahih_international: Then should We turn the message away, disregarding you, because you are a transgressing people?
5.pickthall: Shall We utterly ignore you because ye are a wanton folk?
5.yusuf_ali: Shall We then take away the Message from you and repel (you), for that ye are a people transgressing beyond bounds?
5.shakir: What! shall We then turn away the reminder from you altogether because you are an extravagant people?
5.muhammad_sarwar: Can We ignore sending you the Quran just because you are a transgressing people?
5.mohsin_khan: Shall We then (warn you not and) take away the Reminder (this Quran) from you, because you are a people Musrifun
5.arberry: Shall We turn away the Remembrance from you, for that you are a prodigal people?

6.sahih_international: And how many a prophet We sent among the former peoples,
6.pickthall: How many a prophet did We send among the men of old!
6.yusuf_ali: But how many were the prophets We sent amongst the peoples of old?
6.shakir: And how many a prophet have We sent among the ancients.
6.muhammad_sarwar: How many Messengers did We send to the ancient people?
6.mohsin_khan: And how many a Prophet have We sent amongst the men of old.
6.arberry: How many a Prophet We sent among the ancients,

7.sahih_international: But there would not come to them a prophet except that they used to ridicule him.
7.pickthall: And never came there unto them a prophet but they used to mock him.
7.yusuf_ali: And never came there a prophet to them but they mocked him.
7.shakir: And there came not to them a prophet but they mocked at him.
7.muhammad_sarwar: No Prophet came to them whom they did not mock.
7.mohsin_khan: And never came there a Prophet to them but they used to mock at him.
7.arberry: but not a Prophet came to them, without they mocked at him;

8.sahih_international: And We destroyed greater than them in [striking] power, and the example of the former peoples has preceded.
8.pickthall: Then We destroyed men mightier than these in prowess; and the example of the men of old hath gone (before them).
8.yusuf_ali: So We destroyed (them)- stronger in power than these;- and (thus) has passed on the Parable of the peoples of old.
8.shakir: Then We destroyed those who were stronger than these in prowess, and the case of the ancients has gone before,
8.muhammad_sarwar: We destroyed the strongest among them in power. The stories of the ancient people have already been mentioned.
8.mohsin_khan: Then We destroyed men stronger (in power) than these, and the example of the ancients has passed away (before them).
8.arberry: so We destroyed men stronger in valour than they, and the example of the ancients passed away.

9.sahih_international: And if you should ask them, "Who has created the heavens and the earth?" they would surely say, "They were created by the Exalted in Might, the Knowing."
9.pickthall: And if thou (Muhammad) ask them: Who created the heavens and the earth, they will surely answer: The Mighty, the Knower created them;
9.yusuf_ali: If thou wert to question them, 'Who created the heavens and the earth?' They would be sure to reply, 'they were created by (Him), the Exalted in Power, Full of Knowledge';-
9.shakir: And if you should ask them, Who created the heavens and the earth? they would most certainly say: The Mighty, the Knowing One, has created them;
9.muhammad_sarwar: (Muhammad), if you ask them, "Who has created the heavens and the earth?" They will certainly say, "The Majestic and All-knowing God has created them".
9.mohsin_khan: And indeed if you ask them, "Who has created the heavens and the earth?" They will surely say: "The All-Mighty, the All-Knower created them."
9.arberry: If thou askest them, 'Who created the heavens and earth?' they will say, 'The All-mighty, the All-knowing created them.'

10.sahih_international: [The one] who has made for you the earth a bed and made for you upon it roads that you might be guided
10.pickthall: Who made the earth a resting-place for you, and placed roads for you therein, that haply ye may find your way;
10.yusuf_ali: (Yea, the same that) has made for you the earth (like a carpet) spread out, and has made for you roads (and channels) therein, in order that ye may find guidance (on the way);
10.shakir: He Who made the earth a resting-place for you, and made in it ways for you that you may go aright;
10.muhammad_sarwar: It is He who has made the earth for you as a cradle and has made roads therein so that you will perhaps seek guidance.
10.mohsin_khan: Who has made for you the earth like a bed, and has made for you roads therein, in order that you may find your way,
10.arberry: He who appointed the earth to be a cradle for you, and appointed ways for you therein, that haply you may be guided;

11.sahih_international: And who sends down rain from the sky in measured amounts, and We revive thereby a dead land - thus will you be brought forth -
11.pickthall: And Who sendeth down water from the sky in (due) measure, and We revive a dead land therewith. Even so will ye be brought forth;
11.yusuf_ali: That sends down (from time to time) rain from the sky in due measure;- and We raise to life therewith a land that is dead; even so will ye be raised (from the dead);-
11.shakir: And He Who sends down water from the cloud according to a measure, then We raise to life thereby a dead country, even thus shall you be brought forth;
11.muhammad_sarwar: It is He who has sent down water from the sky in a known measure by which He has given life to the dead earth. In the same way will you also be resurrected.
11.mohsin_khan: And Who sends down water (rain) from the sky in due measure. Then We revive a dead land therewith, and even so you will be brought forth (from the dead),
11.arberry: and who sent down out of heaven water in measure; and We revived thereby a land that was dead; even so you shall be brought forth;

12.sahih_international: And who created the species, all of them, and has made for you of ships and animals those which you mount.
12.pickthall: He Who created all the pairs, and appointed for you ships and cattle whereupon ye ride.
12.yusuf_ali: That has created pairs in all things, and has made for you ships and cattle on which ye ride,
12.shakir: And He Who created pairs of all things, and made for you of the ships and the cattle what you ride on,
12.muhammad_sarwar: It is He who has created everything in pairs and the ships and cattle for you to ride,
12.mohsin_khan: And Who has created all the pairs and has appointed for you ships and cattle on which you ride,
12.arberry: and who created the pairs, all of them, and appointed for you ships and cattle such as you ride,

13.sahih_international: That you may settle yourselves upon their backs and then remember the favor of your Lord when you have settled upon them and say. "Exalted is He who has subjected this to us, and we could not have [otherwise] subdued it.
13.pickthall: That ye may mount upon their backs, and may remember your Lord's favour when ye mount thereon, and may say: Glorified be He Who hath subdued these unto us, and we were not capable (of subduing them);
13.yusuf_ali: In order that ye may sit firm and square on their backs, and when so seated, ye may celebrate the (kind) favour of your Lord, and say, "Glory to Him Who has subjected these to our (use), for we could never have accomplished this (by ourselves),
13.shakir: That you may firmly sit on their backs, then remember the favor of your Lord when you are firmly seated thereon, and say: Glory be to Him Who made this subservient to us and we were not able to do it
13.muhammad_sarwar: so that perhaps when you ride them, you will recall the bounties of your Lord and when you establish your control over it you would say, "Glory belongs to Him who has made it subservient to us when we would not have been able to do so ourselves.
13.mohsin_khan: In order that you may mount firmly on their backs, and then may remember the Favour of your Lord when you mount thereon, and say: "Glory to Him who has subjected this to us, and we could never have it (by our efforts)."
13.arberry: that you may be seated on their backs and then remember your Lord's blessing when you are seated on them, and say, 'Glory be to Him, who has subjected this to us, and we ourselves were not equal to it;

14.sahih_international: And indeed we, to our Lord, will [surely] return."
14.pickthall: And lo! unto our Lord we surely are returning.
14.yusuf_ali: "And to our Lord, surely, must we turn back!"
14.shakir: And surely to our Lord we must return.
14.muhammad_sarwar: To our Lord we shall all return".
14.mohsin_khan: And verily, to Our Lord we indeed are to return!
14.arberry: surely unto our Lord we are turning.'

15.sahih_international: But they have attributed to Him from His servants a portion. Indeed, man is clearly ungrateful.
15.pickthall: And they allot to Him a portion of His bondmen! Lo! man is verily a mere ingrate.
15.yusuf_ali: Yet they attribute to some of His servants a share with Him (in his godhead)! truly is man a blasphemous ingrate avowed!
15.shakir: And they assign to Him a part of His servants; man, to be sure, is clearly ungrateful.
15.muhammad_sarwar: The pagans have considered some of His servants as His children. There is no doubt that the human being is simply ungrateful.
15.mohsin_khan: Yet they assign to some of His slaves a share with Him (by pretending that He has children, and considering them as equals or co-partners in worship with Him). Verily, man is indeed a manifest ingrate!
15.arberry: Yet they have assigned to Him a part of His own servants! Man is dearly unthankful.

16.sahih_international: Or has He taken, out of what He has created, daughters and chosen you for [having] sons?
16.pickthall: Or chooseth He daughters of all that He hath created, and honoureth He you with sons?
16.yusuf_ali: What! has He taken daughters out of what He himself creates, and granted to you sons for choice?
16.shakir: What! has He taken daughters to Himself of what He Himself creates and chosen you to have sons?
16.muhammad_sarwar: Has God chosen some of His own creatures as daughters for Himself and has given you the preference of having sons?
16.mohsin_khan: Or has He taken daughters out of what He has created, and He has selected for you sons?
16.arberry: Or has He taken to Himself, from that He creates, daughters, and favoured you with sons?

17.sahih_international: And when one of them is given good tidings of that which he attributes to the Most Merciful in comparison, his face becomes dark, and he suppresses grief.
17.pickthall: And if one of them hath tidings of that which he likeneth to the Beneficent One, his countenance becometh black and he is full of inward rage.
17.yusuf_ali: When news is brought to one of them of (the birth of) what he sets up as a likeness to (Allah) Most Gracious, his face darkens, and he is filled with inward grief!
17.shakir: And when one of them is given news of that of which he sets up as a likeness for the Beneficent Allah, his face becomes black and he is full of rage.
17.muhammad_sarwar: When one of them is given the glad news of the birth of a daughter, which they believe to be the only kind of child that the Beneficent God can have, his face blackens with anger.
17.mohsin_khan: And if one of them is informed of the news of (the birth of) that which he set forth as a parable to the Most Beneficent (Allah) (i.e. of a girl), his face becomes dark, gloomy, and he is filled with grief!
17.arberry: And when any of them is given the good tidings of that he has likened to the All-merciful, his face is darkened, and he chokes inwardly.

18.sahih_international: So is one brought up in ornaments while being during conflict unevident [attributed to Allah]?
18.pickthall: (Liken they then to Allah) that which is bred up in outward show, and in dispute cannot make itself plain?
18.yusuf_ali: Is then one brought up among trinkets, and unable to give a clear account in a dispute (to be associated with Allah)?
18.shakir: What! that which is made in ornaments and which in contention is unable to make plain speech!
18.muhammad_sarwar: Does God choose for Himself the kind of children who grow up wearing ornaments and who are not strong enough to defend their rights?
18.mohsin_khan: (Do they then like for Allah) a creature who is brought up in adornments (wearing silk and gold ornaments, i.e. women), and in dispute cannot make herself clear?
18.arberry: What, one who is reared amid ornaments and, when the time of altercation comes, is not to be seen?

19.sahih_international: And they have made the angels, who are servants of the Most Merciful, females. Did they witness their creation? Their testimony will be recorded, and they will be questioned.
19.pickthall: And they make the angels, who are the slaves of the Beneficent, females. Did they witness their creation? Their testimony will be recorded and they will be questioned.
19.yusuf_ali: And they make into females angels who themselves serve Allah. Did they witness their creation? Their evidence will be recorded, and they will be called to account!
19.shakir: And they make the angels-- them who are the servants of the Beneficent Allah-- female (divinities). What! did they witness their creation? Their evidence shall be written down and they shall be questioned.
19.muhammad_sarwar: Do they say that the angels, who are the servants of the Beneficent God, are females? Have they witnessed their creation? Their words as such will be recorded and they will be questioned for it.
19.mohsin_khan: And they make the angels who themselves are slaves to the Most Beneficent (Allah) females. Did they witness their creation? Their evidence will be recorded, and they will be questioned!
19.arberry: And they have made the angels, who are themselves servants of the All-merciful, females. What, did they witness their creation? Their witness shall be written down, and they shall be questioned.

20.sahih_international: And they said, "If the Most Merciful had willed, we would not have worshipped them." They have of that no knowledge. They are not but falsifying.
20.pickthall: And they say: If the Beneficent One had (so) willed, we should not have worshipped them. They have no knowledge whatsoever of that. They do but guess.
20.yusuf_ali: ("Ah!") they say, "If it had been the will of (Allah) Most Gracious, we should not have worshipped such (deities)!" Of that they have no knowledge! they do nothing but lie!
20.shakir: And they say: If the Beneficent Allah had pleased, we should never have worshipped them. They have no knowledge of this; they only lie.
20.muhammad_sarwar: The pagans say, "Had the Beneficent God wanted, we would not have worshipped them (idols)." Whatever they say is not based on knowledge. It is only a false conjecture.
20.mohsin_khan: And they said: "If it had been the Will of the Most Beneficent (Allah), we should not have worshipped them (false deities)." They have no knowledge whatsoever of that. They do nothing but lie!
20.arberry: They say, 'Had the All-merciful so willed, we would not have served them.' They have no knowledge of that; they are only conjecturing.

21.sahih_international: Or have We given them a book before the Qur'an to which they are adhering?
21.pickthall: Or have We given them any scripture before (this Qur'an) so that they are holding fast thereto?
21.yusuf_ali: What! have We given them a Book before this, to which they are holding fast?
21.shakir: Or have We given them a book before it so that they hold fast to it?
21.muhammad_sarwar: Had We, before sending the Quran, given them a book to which they now refer as an authority?
21.mohsin_khan: Or have We given them any Book before this (the Quran), to which they are holding fast?
21.arberry: Or did We bring them a Book aforetime to which they hold?

22.sahih_international: Rather, they say, "Indeed, we found our fathers upon a religion, and we are in their footsteps [rightly] guided."
22.pickthall: Nay, for they say only: Lo! we found our fathers following a religion, and we are guided by their footprints.
22.yusuf_ali: Nay! they say: "We found our fathers following a certain religion, and we do guide ourselves by their footsteps."
22.shakir: Nay! they say: We found our fathers on a course, and surely we are guided by their footsteps.
22.muhammad_sarwar: In fact, they say, "We found our fathers following a certain belief and we now follow in their footsteps for our guidance".
22.mohsin_khan: Nay! They say: "We found our fathers following a certain way and religion, and we guide ourselves by their footsteps."
22.arberry: Nay, but they say, 'We found our fathers upon a community, and we are guided upon their traces.'

23.sahih_international: And similarly, We did not send before you any warner into a city except that its affluent said, "Indeed, we found our fathers upon a religion, and we are, in their footsteps, following."
23.pickthall: And even so We sent not a warner before thee (Muhammad) into any township but its luxurious ones said: Lo! we found our fathers following a religion, and we are following their footprints.
23.yusuf_ali: Just in the same way, whenever We sent a Warner before thee to any people, the wealthy ones among them said: "We found our fathers following a certain religion, and we will certainly follow in their footsteps."
23.shakir: And thus, We did not send before you any warner in a town, but those who led easy lives in it said: Surely we found our fathers on a course, and surely we are followers of their footsteps.
23.muhammad_sarwar: In the same way, whenever We had sent a Messenger before you to warn a town, the rich ones therein said, "We found our fathers following a certain belief and we follow in their footsteps.
23.mohsin_khan: And similarly, We sent not a warner before you (O Muhammad SAW) to any town (people) but the luxurious ones among them said: "We found our fathers following a certain way and religion, and we will indeed follow their footsteps."
23.arberry: Even so We sent never before thee any warner into any city, except that its men who lived at ease said, 'We indeed found our fathers upon a community, and we are following upon their traces.'

24.sahih_international: [Each warner] said, "Even if I brought you better guidance than that [religion] upon which you found your fathers?" They said, "Indeed we, in that with which you were sent, are disbelievers."
24.pickthall: (And the warner) said: What! Even though I bring you better guidance than that ye found your fathers following? They answered: Lo! in what ye bring we are disbelievers.
24.yusuf_ali: He said: "What! Even if I brought you better guidance than that which ye found your fathers following?" They said: "For us, we deny that ye (prophets) are sent (on a mission at all)."
24.shakir: (The warner) said: What! even if I bring to you a better guide than that on which you found your fathers? They said: Surely we are unbelievers in that with which you are sent.
24.muhammad_sarwar: The Messengers would say, "Would you still follow in the footsteps of your fathers even if I was to bring you better guidance?" They would say, "We have no faith in your message".
24.mohsin_khan: (The warner) said: "Even if I bring you better guidance than that which you found your fathers following?" They said: "Verily, We disbelieve in that with which you have been sent."
24.arberry: Say: 'What, though I should bring you a better guidance than you found your fathers upon?' They say, 'We disbelieve in that you were sent with.'

25.sahih_international: So we took retribution from them; then see how was the end of the deniers.
25.pickthall: So We requited them. Then see the nature of the consequence for the rejecters!
25.yusuf_ali: So We exacted retribution from them: now see what was the end of those who rejected (Truth)!
25.shakir: So We inflicted retribution on them, then see how was the end of the rejecters.
25.muhammad_sarwar: We took revenge on them. See how terrible the end of those who rejected (Or revelations) was!
25.mohsin_khan: So We took revenge of them, then see what was the end of those who denied (Islamic Monotheism).
25.arberry: So We took vengeance upon them; and behold how was the end of them that cried lies.

26.sahih_international: And [mention, O Muhammad], when Abraham said to his father and his people, "Indeed, I am disassociated from that which you worship
26.pickthall: And when Abraham said unto his father and his folk: Lo! I am innocent of what ye worship
26.yusuf_ali: Behold! Abraham said to his father and his people: "I do indeed clear myself of what ye worship:
26.shakir: And when Ibrahim said to his father and his people: Surely I am clear of what you worship,
26.muhammad_sarwar: When Abraham said to his father and his people, "I boldly renounce what you worship
26.mohsin_khan: And (remember) when Ibrahim (Abraham) said to his father and his people: "Verily, I am innocent of what you worship,
26.arberry: And when Abraham said to his father and his people, 'Surely I am quit of that you serve,

27.sahih_international: Except for He who created me; and indeed, He will guide me."
27.pickthall: Save Him Who did create me, for He will surely guide me.
27.yusuf_ali: "(I worship) only Him Who made me, and He will certainly guide me."
27.shakir: Save Him Who created me, for surely He will guide me.
27.muhammad_sarwar: except for the One who has created me and will guide me".
27.mohsin_khan: "Except Him (i.e. I worship none but Allah Alone) Who did create me, and verily, He will guide me."
27.arberry: except Him who originated me; and He will guide me.

28.sahih_international: And he made it a word remaining among his descendants that they might return [to it].
28.pickthall: And he made it a word enduring among his seed, that haply they might return.
28.yusuf_ali: And he left it as a Word to endure among those who came after him, that they may turn back (to Allah).
28.shakir: And he made it a word to continue in his posterity that they may return.
28.muhammad_sarwar: God made (belief in one God) an everlasting task for his successors, so that perhaps they would return (to Him).
28.mohsin_khan: And he made it [i.e. La ilaha ill-Allah (none has the right to be worshipped but Allah Alone)] a Word lasting among his offspring (True Monotheism), that they may turn back (i.e. to repent to Allah or receive admonition).
28.arberry: And he made it a word enduring among his posterity; haply so they would return.

29.sahih_international: However, I gave enjoyment to these [people of Makkah] and their fathers until there came to them the truth and a clear Messenger.
29.pickthall: Nay, but I let these and their fathers enjoy life (only) till there should come unto them the Truth and a messenger making plain.
29.yusuf_ali: Yea, I have given the good things of this life to these (men) and their fathers, until the Truth has come to them, and a messenger making things clear.
29.shakir: Nay! I gave them and their fathers to enjoy until there came to them the truth and an Apostle making manifest (the truth).
29.muhammad_sarwar: In fact, We allowed them and their fathers to enjoy themselves until the truth and a strong Messenger came to them.
29.mohsin_khan: Nay, but I gave (the good things of this life) to these (polytheists) and their fathers to enjoy, till there came to them the truth (the Quran), and a Messenger (Muhammad SAW) making things clear.
29.arberry: Nay, but I gave these and their fathers enjoyment of days, until the truth came unto them, and a manifest Messenger.

30.sahih_international: But when the truth came to them, they said, "This is magic, and indeed we are, concerning it, disbelievers."
30.pickthall: And now that the Truth hath come unto them they say: This is mere magic, and lo! we are disbelievers therein.
30.yusuf_ali: But when the Truth came to them, they said: "This is sorcery, and we do reject it."
30.shakir: And when there came to them the truth they said: This is magic, and surely we are disbelievers in it.
30.muhammad_sarwar: When the truth came to them, they said, "This is magic and we have no faith in it".
30.mohsin_khan: And when the truth (this Quran) came to them, they (the disbelievers in this Quran) said: "This is magic, and we disbelieve therein."
30.arberry: And when the truth came to them, they said, 'This is a sorcery, and in it we are unbelievers.'

31.sahih_international: And they said, "Why was this Qur'an not sent down upon a great man from [one of] the two cities?"
31.pickthall: And they say: If only this Qur'an had been revealed to some great man of the two towns?
31.yusuf_ali: Also, they say: "Why is not this Qur'an sent down to some leading man in either of the two (chief) cities?"
31.shakir: And they say: Why was not this Quran revealed to a man of importance in the two towns?
31.muhammad_sarwar: Then they said, "Why this Quran had not been revealed to a man from either of the two great towns".
31.mohsin_khan: And they say: "Why is not this Quran sent down to some great man of the two towns (Makkah and Ta'if)?"
31.arberry: They say, 'Why was this Koran not sent down upon some man of moment in the two cities?'

32.sahih_international: Do they distribute the mercy of your Lord? It is We who have apportioned among them their livelihood in the life of this world and have raised some of them above others in degrees [of rank] that they may make use of one another for service. But the mercy of your Lord is better than whatever they accumulate.
32.pickthall: Is it they who apportion thy Lord's mercy? We have apportioned among them their livelihood in the life of the world, and raised some of them above others in rank that some of them may take labour from others; and the mercy of thy Lord is better than (the wealth) that they amass.
32.yusuf_ali: Is it they who would portion out the Mercy of thy Lord? It is We Who portion out between them their livelihood in the life of this world: and We raise some of them above others in ranks, so that some may command work from others. But the Mercy of thy Lord is better than the (wealth) which they amass.
32.shakir: Will they distribute the mercy of your Lord? We distribute among them their livelihood in the life of this world, and We j have exalted some of them above others in degrees, that some of them may take others in subjection; and the mercy of your Lord is better than what they amass.
32.muhammad_sarwar: Do they distribute the mercy of your Lord? It is We who have distributed their sustenance in this world and raised the positions of some of them above the others so that they would mock each other. The mercy of your Lord is better than what they can amass.
32.mohsin_khan: Is it they who would portion out the Mercy of your Lord? It is We Who portion out between them their livelihood in this world, and We raised some of them above others in ranks, so that some may employ others in their work. But the Mercy (Paradise) of your Lord (O Muhammad SAW) is better than the (wealth of this world) which they amass.
32.arberry: What, is it they who divide the mercy of the Lord? We have divided between them their livelihood in the present life, and raised some of them above others in rank, that some of them may take others in servitude; and the mercy of thy Lord is better than that they amass.

33.sahih_international: And if it were not that the people would become one community [of disbelievers], We would have made for those who disbelieve in the Most Merciful - for their houses - ceilings and stairways of silver upon which to mount
33.pickthall: And were it not that mankind would have become one community, We might well have appointed, for those who disbelieve in the Beneficent, roofs of silver for their houses and stairs (of silver) whereby to mount,
33.yusuf_ali: And were it not that (all) men might become of one (evil) way of life, We would provide, for everyone that blasphemes against (Allah) Most Gracious, silver roofs for their houses and (silver) stair-ways on which to go up,
33.shakir: And were it not that all people had been a single nation, We would certainly have assigned to those who disbelieve in the Beneficent Allah (to make) of silver the roofs of their houses and the stairs by which they ascend.
33.muhammad_sarwar: Were it not for the fear that all people would become one in disbelief, We would have made for the disbelievers in the Beneficent God ceilings out of silver and ladders by which they would climb up,
33.mohsin_khan: And were it not that all mankind would have become of one community (all disbelievers, desiring worldly life only), We would have provided for those who disbelieve in the Most Beneficent (Allah), silver roofs for their houses, and elevators (and stair-ways, etc. of silver) whereby they ascend,
33.arberry: And were it not that mankind would be one nation, We would have appointed for those who disbelieve in the All-merciful roofs of silver to their houses, and stairs whereon to mount,

34.sahih_international: And for their houses - doors and couches [of silver] upon which to recline
34.pickthall: And for their houses doors (of silver) and couches of silver whereon to recline,
34.yusuf_ali: And (silver) doors to their houses, and thrones (of silver) on which they could recline,
34.shakir: And the doors of their houses and the couches on which they recline,
34.muhammad_sarwar: doors for their houses, couches on which to recline,
34.mohsin_khan: And for their houses, doors (of silver), and thrones (of silver) on which they could recline,
34.arberry: and doors to their houses, and couches whereon to recline,

35.sahih_international: And gold ornament. But all that is not but the enjoyment of worldly life. And the Hereafter with your Lord is for the righteous.
35.pickthall: And ornaments of gold. Yet all that would have been but a provision of the life of the world. And the Hereafter with your Lord would have been for those who keep from evil.
35.yusuf_ali: And also adornments of gold. But all this were nothing but conveniences of the present life: The Hereafter, in the sight of thy Lord is for the Righteous.
35.shakir: And (other) embellishments of gold; and all this is naught but provision of this world's life, and the hereafter is with your Lord only for those who guard (against evil).
35.muhammad_sarwar: and other ornament of gold. All these are only the means of enjoyment in this world, but the pious will receive their reward from your Lord in the life hereafter.
35.mohsin_khan: And adornments of gold. Yet all this (i.e. the roofs, doors, stairs, elevators, thrones etc. of their houses) would have been nothing but an enjoyment of this world. And the Hereafter with your Lord is only for the Muttaqun.
35.arberry: and ornaments; surely all this is but the enjoyment of the present life, and the world to come with thy Lord is for the godfearing.

36.sahih_international: And whoever is blinded from remembrance of the Most Merciful - We appoint for him a devil, and he is to him a companion.
36.pickthall: And he whose sight is dim to the remembrance of the Beneficent, We assign unto him a devil who becometh his comrade;
36.yusuf_ali: If anyone withdraws himself from remembrance of (Allah) Most Gracious, We appoint for him an evil one, to be an intimate companion to him.
36.shakir: And whoever turns himself away from the remembrance of the Beneficent Allah, We appoint for him a Shaitan, so he becomes his associate.
36.muhammad_sarwar: We shall make satan the companion of whoever ignores the remembrance of the Beneficent God.
36.mohsin_khan: And whosoever turns away (blinds himself) from the remembrance of the Most Beneficent (Allah) (i.e. this Quran and worship of Allah), We appoint for him Shaitan (Satan - devil) to be a Qarin (an intimate companion) to him.
36.arberry: Whoso blinds himself to the Remembrance of the All-merciful, to him We assign a Satan for comrade;

37.sahih_international: And indeed, the devils avert them from the way [of guidance] while they think that they are [rightly] guided
37.pickthall: And lo! they surely turn them from the way of Allah, and yet they deem that they are rightly guided;
37.yusuf_ali: Such (evil ones) really hinder them from the Path, but they think that they are being guided aright!
37.shakir: And most surely they turn them away from the path, and they think that they are guided aright:
37.muhammad_sarwar: Satan will prevent them from the right path while they think that they have the right guidance.
37.mohsin_khan: And verily, they (Satans / devils) hinder them from the Path (of Allah), but they think that they are guided aright!
37.arberry: and they bar them from the way, and they think they are guided,

38.sahih_international: Until, when he comes to Us [at Judgement], he says [to his companion], "Oh, I wish there was between me and you the distance between the east and west - how wretched a companion."
38.pickthall: Till, when he cometh unto Us, he saith (unto his comrade): Ah, would that between me and thee there were the distance of the two horizons - an evil comrade!
38.yusuf_ali: At length, when (such a one) comes to Us, he says (to his evil companion): "Would that between me and thee were the distance of East and West!" Ah! evil is the companion (indeed)!
38.shakir: Until when he comes to Us, he says: O would that between me and you there were the distance of the East and the West; so evil is the associate!
38.muhammad_sarwar: When he returns to us, he will say (to satan), "Would that there had been as long a distance between me and you as that between the East and West. What a terrible companion you have been".
38.mohsin_khan: Till, when (such a one) comes to Us, he says [to his Qarin (Satan / devil companion)] "Would that between me and you were the distance of the two easts (or the east and west)" a worst (type of) companion (indeed)!
38.arberry: till, when he comes to Us, he says, 'Would there had been between me and thee the distance of the two Easts!' An evil comrade!

39.sahih_international: And never will it benefit you that Day, when you have wronged, that you are [all] sharing in the punishment.
39.pickthall: And it profiteth you not this day, because ye did wrong, that ye will be sharers in the doom.
39.yusuf_ali: When ye have done wrong, it will avail you nothing, that Day, that ye shall be partners in Punishment!
39.shakir: And since you were unjust, it will not profit you this day that you are sharers in the chastisement.
39.muhammad_sarwar: They will be told on the Day of Judgment, "Regret will never be of any benefit to you. You have done injustice to your souls and you will share the torment".
39.mohsin_khan: It will profit you not this Day (O you who turn away from Allah's remembrance and His worship, etc.) as you did wrong, (and) that you will be sharers (you and your Qarin) in the punishment.
39.arberry: It shall not profit you today, since you did evil, that you are partners in the chastisement.

40.sahih_international: Then will you make the deaf hear, [O Muhammad], or guide the blind or he who is in clear error?
40.pickthall: Canst thou (Muhammad) make the deaf to hear, or canst thou guide the blind or him who is in error manifest?
40.yusuf_ali: Canst thou then make the deaf to hear, or give direction to the blind or to such as (wander) in manifest error?
40.shakir: What! can you then make the deaf to hear or guide the blind and him who is in clear error?
40.muhammad_sarwar: (Muhammad), can you make the deaf hear or guide the blind or the one who is clearly in error?
40.mohsin_khan: Can you (O Muhammad SAW) make the deaf to hear, or can you guide the blind or him who is in manifest error?
40.arberry: What, shalt thou make the deaf to hear, or shalt thou guide the blind and him who is in manifest error?

41.sahih_international: And whether [or not] We take you away [in death], indeed, We will take retribution upon them.
41.pickthall: And if We take thee away, We surely shall take vengeance on them,
41.yusuf_ali: Even if We take thee away, We shall be sure to exact retribution from them,
41.shakir: But if We should take you away, still We shall inflict retribution on them;
41.muhammad_sarwar: We shall revenge them either after your death
41.mohsin_khan: And even if We take you (O Muhammad SAW) away, We shall indeed take vengeance on them.
41.arberry: Whether We take thee away, We shall take vengeance upon them,

42.sahih_international: Or whether [or not] We show you that which We have promised them, indeed, We are Perfect in Ability.
42.pickthall: Or (if) We show thee that wherewith We threaten them; for lo! We have complete command of them.
42.yusuf_ali: Or We shall show thee that (accomplished) which We have promised them: for verily We shall prevail over them.
42.shakir: Rather We will certainly show you that which We have promised them; for surely We are the possessors of full power over them.
42.muhammad_sarwar: or show them to you suffering the torment with which We had threatened them. We are certainly dominant over them all.
42.mohsin_khan: Or (if) We show you that wherewith We threaten them, then verily, We have perfect command over them.
42.arberry: or We show thee a part of that We promised them, surely We have power over them.

43.sahih_international: So adhere to that which is revealed to you. Indeed, you are on a straight path.
43.pickthall: So hold thou fast to that which is inspired in thee. Lo! thou art on a right path.
43.yusuf_ali: So hold thou fast to the Revelation sent down to thee; verily thou art on a Straight Way.
43.shakir: Therefore hold fast to that which has been revealed to you; surely you are on the right path.
43.muhammad_sarwar: Follow devotedly that which is revealed to you. You are certainly on the right path.
43.mohsin_khan: So hold you (O Muhammad SAW) fast to that which is inspired in you. Verily, you are on a Straight Path.
43.arberry: So hold thou fast unto that which has been revealed unto thee; surely thou art upon a straight path.

44.sahih_international: And indeed, it is a remembrance for you and your people, and you [all] are going to be questioned.
44.pickthall: And lo! it is in truth a Reminder for thee and for thy folk; and ye will be questioned.
44.yusuf_ali: The (Qur'an) is indeed the message, for thee and for thy people; and soon shall ye (all) be brought to account.
44.shakir: And most surely it is a reminder for you and your people, and you shall soon be questioned.
44.muhammad_sarwar: The Quran is a reminder to you and to your people and you will soon be questioned about it.
44.mohsin_khan: And verily, this (the Quran) is indeed a Reminder for you (O Muhammad SAW) and your people (Quraish people, or your followers), and you will be questioned (about it).
44.arberry: Surely it is a Reminder to thee and to thy people; and assuredly you will be questioned.

45.sahih_international: And ask those We sent before you of Our messengers; have We made besides the Most Merciful deities to be worshipped?
45.pickthall: And ask those of Our messengers whom We sent before thee: Did We ever appoint gods to be worshipped beside the Beneficent?
45.yusuf_ali: And question thou our messengers whom We sent before thee; did We appoint any deities other than (Allah) Most Gracious, to be worshipped?
45.shakir: And ask those of Our apostles whom We sent before you: Did We ever appoint gods to be worshipped besides the Beneficent Allah?
45.muhammad_sarwar: You can ask Our Messengers whom We sent before you if We had commanded them to worship other gods besides the Beneficent God?"
45.mohsin_khan: And ask (O Muhammad SAW) those of Our Messengers whom We sent before you: "Did We ever appoint aliha (gods) to be worshipped besides the Most Beneficent (Allah)?"
45.arberry: Ask those of Our Messengers We sent before thee: Have We appointed, apart from the All-merciful, gods to be served?

46.sahih_international: And certainly did We send Moses with Our signs to Pharaoh and his establishment, and he said, "Indeed, I am the messenger of the Lord of the worlds."
46.pickthall: And verily We sent Moses with Our revelations unto Pharaoh and his chiefs, and he said: I am a messenger of the Lord of the Worlds.
46.yusuf_ali: We did send Moses aforetime, with Our Signs, to Pharaoh and his Chiefs: He said, "I am a messenger of the Lord of the Worlds."
46.shakir: And certainly We sent Musa with Our communications to Firon and his chiefs, so he said: Surely I am the apostle of the Lord of the worlds.
46.muhammad_sarwar: We sent Moses to the Pharaoh and his nobles with Our miracles and he said, "I am the Messenger of the Lord of the Universe".
46.mohsin_khan: And indeed We did send Musa (Moses) with Our Ayat (proofs, evidences, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.) to Fir'aun (Pharaoh) and his chiefs (inviting them to Allah's Religion of Islam) He said: "Verily, I am a Messenger of the Lord of the 'Alamin (mankind, jinns and all that exists)."
46.arberry: We also sent Moses with Our signs to Pharaoh and his Council, and he said, 'Surely, I am the Messenger of the Lord of all Being.'

47.sahih_international: But when he brought them Our signs, at once they laughed at them.
47.pickthall: But when he brought them Our tokens, behold! they laughed at them.
47.yusuf_ali: But when he came to them with Our Signs, behold they ridiculed them.
47.shakir: But when he came to them with Our signs, lo! they laughed at them.
47.muhammad_sarwar: When he showed them Our miracles, they started to laugh at them.
47.mohsin_khan: But when he came to them with Our Ayat (proofs, evidences, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.) behold! They laughed at them.
47.arberry: But when he brought them Our signs, lo, they laughed at them.

48.sahih_international: And We showed them not a sign except that it was greater than its sister, and We seized them with affliction that perhaps they might return [to faith].
48.pickthall: And every token that We showed them was greater than its sister (token), and We grasped them with the torment, that haply they might turn again.
48.yusuf_ali: We showed them Sign after Sign, each greater than its fellow, and We seized them with Punishment, in order that they might turn (to Us).
48.shakir: And We did not show them a sign but it was greater than its like, and We overtook them with chastisement that they may turn.
48.muhammad_sarwar: Of all the miracles which We showed to them the latter ones were greater than the former. We struck them with torment so that perhaps they would return to Us.
48.mohsin_khan: And not an Ayah (sign, etc.) We showed them but it was greater than its fellow, and We seized them with torment, in order that they might turn [from their polytheism to Allah's Religion (Islamic Monotheism)].
48.arberry: And not a sign We showed them, but it was greater than its sister sign; and We seized them with chastisement, that haply they should return.

49.sahih_international: And they said [to Moses], "O magician, invoke for us your Lord by what He has promised you. Indeed, we will be guided."
49.pickthall: And they said: O wizard! Entreat thy Lord for us by the pact that He hath made with thee. Lo! we verily will walk aright.
49.yusuf_ali: And they said, "O thou sorcerer! Invoke thy Lord for us according to His covenant with thee; for we shall truly accept guidance."
49.shakir: And they said: O magician! call on your Lord for our sake, as He has made the covenant with you; we shall surely be the followers of the right way.
49.muhammad_sarwar: They said, "Magician, pray to your Lord for us through your covenant with Him (If he saves us from the torment), we shall certainly seek guidance".
49.mohsin_khan: And they said [to Musa (Moses)]: "O you sorcerer! Invoke your Lord for us according to what He has covenanted with you. Verily, We shall guide ourselves (aright)."
49.arberry: And they said, 'Sorcerer, pray to thy Lord for us by the covenant He has made with thee, and surely we shall be right-guided.'

50.sahih_international: But when We removed from them the affliction, at once they broke their word.
50.pickthall: But when We eased them of the torment, behold! they broke their word.
50.yusuf_ali: But when We removed the Penalty from them, behold, they broke their word.
50.shakir: But when We removed from them the chastisement, lo! they broke the pledge.
50.muhammad_sarwar: When We relieved them from the torment they suddenly turned back on their heels.
50.mohsin_khan: But when We removed the torment from them, behold! They broke their covenant (that they will believe if We remove the torment for them).
50.arberry: But when We removed from them the chastisement, behold, they broke their troth.

51.sahih_international: And Pharaoh called out among his people; he said, "O my people, does not the kingdom of Egypt belong to me, and these rivers flowing beneath me; then do you not see?
51.pickthall: And Pharaoh caused a proclamation to be made among his people saying: O my people! Is not mine the sovereignty of Egypt and these rivers flowing under me? Can ye not then discern?
51.yusuf_ali: And Pharaoh proclaimed among his people, saying: "O my people! Does not the dominion of Egypt belong to me, (witness) these streams flowing underneath my (palace)? What! see ye not then?
51.shakir: And Firon proclaimed amongst his people: O my people! is not the kingdom of Egypt mine? And these rivers flow beneath me; do you not then see?
51.muhammad_sarwar: The Pharaoh shouted to his people, "My people, is the kingdom of Egypt not mine? and can you not see that the streams flow from beneath my palace?
51.mohsin_khan: And Fir'aun (Pharaoh) proclaimed among his people, saying: "O my people! Is not mine the dominion of Egypt, and these rivers flowing underneath me. See you not then?
51.arberry: And Pharaoh proclaimed among his people: 'O my people, do I not possess the kingdom of Egypt, and these rivers flowing beneath me? What, do you not see?

52.sahih_international: Or am I [not] better than this one who is insignificant and hardly makes himself clear?
52.pickthall: I am surely better than this fellow, who is despicable and can hardly make (his meaning) plain!
52.yusuf_ali: "Am I not better than this (Moses), who is a contemptible wretch and can scarcely express himself clearly?
52.shakir: Nay! I am better than this fellow, who is contemptible, and who can hardly speak distinctly:
52.muhammad_sarwar: Am I not better than this lowly man who can barely express himself?
52.mohsin_khan: "Am I not better than this one [Musa (Moses)], who is Mahin [has no honour nor any respect, and is weak and despicable] and can scarcely express himself clearly?
52.arberry: Or am I better than this man, who is contemptible and scarcely makes things clear?

53.sahih_international: Then why have there not been placed upon him bracelets of gold or come with him the angels in conjunction?"
53.pickthall: Why, then, have armlets of gold not been set upon him, or angels sent along with him?
53.yusuf_ali: "Then why are not gold bracelets bestowed on him, or (why) come (not) with him angels accompanying him in procession?"
53.shakir: But why have not bracelets of gold been put upon him, or why have there not come with him angels as companions?
53.muhammad_sarwar: Why have bracelets of gold not been given to him and why have some angels not accompanied him?"
53.mohsin_khan: "Why then are not golden bracelets bestowed on him, or angels sent along with him?"
53.arberry: Why then have bracelets of gold not been cast on him, or angels not come with him conjoined?'

54.sahih_international: So he bluffed his people, and they obeyed him. Indeed, they were [themselves] a people defiantly disobedient [of Allah].
54.pickthall: Thus he persuaded his people to make light (of Moses), and they obeyed him. Lo! they were a wanton folk.
54.yusuf_ali: Thus did he make fools of his people, and they obeyed him: truly were they a people rebellious (against Allah).
54.shakir: So he incited his people to levity and they obeyed him: surely they were a transgressing people.
54.muhammad_sarwar: Thus, he made dimwits out of his people and they followed him. They, certainly, were a sinful people. When they invoked Our anger,
54.mohsin_khan: Thus he [Fir'aun (Pharaoh)] befooled and misled his people, and they obeyed him. Verily, they were ever a people who were Fasiqun (rebellious, disobedient to Allah).
54.arberry: So he made his people unsteady, and they obeyed him; surely they were an ungodly people.

55.sahih_international: And when they angered Us, We took retribution from them and drowned them all.
55.pickthall: So, when they angered Us, We punished them and drowned them every one.
55.yusuf_ali: When at length they provoked Us, We exacted retribution from them, and We drowned them all.
55.shakir: Then when they displeased Us, We inflicted a retribution on them, so We drowned them all together,
55.muhammad_sarwar: We took revenge on them by drowning them all together.
55.mohsin_khan: So when they angered Us, We punished them, and drowned them all.
55.arberry: So, when they had angered Us, We took vengeance on them, and We drowned them all together;

56.sahih_international: And We made them a precedent and an example for the later peoples.
56.pickthall: And We made them a thing past, and an example for those after (them).
56.yusuf_ali: And We made them (a people) of the Past and an Example to later ages.
56.shakir: And We made them a precedent and example to the later generations.
56.muhammad_sarwar: We made them become of the people of the past and an example for the coming generations.
56.mohsin_khan: And We made them a precedent (as a lesson for those coming after them), and an example to later generations.
56.arberry: and We made them a thing past, and We appointed them for an example to later folk.

57.sahih_international: And when the son of Mary was presented as an example, immediately your people laughed aloud.
57.pickthall: And when the son of Mary is quoted as an example, behold! the folk laugh out,
57.yusuf_ali: When (Jesus) the son of Mary is held up as an example, behold, thy people raise a clamour thereat (in ridicule)!
57.shakir: And when a description of the son of Marium is given, lo! your people raise a clamor thereat.
57.muhammad_sarwar: When the son of Mary was mentioned as an example, you people cried out in protest, saying,
57.mohsin_khan: And when the son of Maryam (Mary) is quoted as an example [i.e. 'Iesa (Jesus) is worshipped like their idols), behold! Your people cry aloud (laugh out at the example).
57.arberry: And when the son of Mary is cited as an example, behold, thy people turn away from it

58.sahih_international: And they said, "Are your gods better, or is he?" They did not present the comparison except for [mere] argument. But, [in fact], they are a people prone to dispute.
58.pickthall: And say: Are our gods better, or is he? They raise not the objection save for argument. Nay! but they are a contentious folk.
58.yusuf_ali: And they say, "Are our gods best, or he?" This they set forth to thee, only by way of disputation: yea, they are a contentious people.
58.shakir: And they say: Are our gods better, or is he? They do not set it forth to you save by way of disputation; nay, they are a contentious people.
58.muhammad_sarwar: "Are our gods any better than Jesus (for according to Muhammad), if our gods go to hell so too will Jesus. What they say is only a false argument. In fact, they are a quarrelsome people.
58.mohsin_khan: And say: "Are our aliha (gods) better or is he ['Iesa (Jesus)]?" They quoted not the above example except for argument. Nay! But they are a quarrelsome people. [(See VV. 21:97-101) - The Quran.]
58.arberry: and say, 'What, are our gods better, or he?' They cite not him to thee, save to dispute;. nay, but they are a people contentious.

59.sahih_international: Jesus was not but a servant upon whom We bestowed favor, and We made him an example for the Children of Israel.
59.pickthall: He is nothing but a slave on whom We bestowed favour, and We made him a pattern for the Children of Israel.
59.yusuf_ali: He was no more than a servant: We granted Our favour to him, and We made him an example to the Children of Israel.
59.shakir: He was naught but a servant on whom We bestowed favor, and We made him an example for the children of Israel.
59.muhammad_sarwar: Jesus was a servant of Ours to whom We had granted favors and whom We made as an example for the Israelites.
59.mohsin_khan: He ['Iesa (Jesus)] was not more than a slave. We granted Our Favour to him, and We made him an example to the Children of Israel (i.e. his creation without a father).
59.arberry: He is only a servant We blessed, and We made him to be an example to the Children of Israel.

60.sahih_international: And if We willed, We could have made [instead] of you angels succeeding [one another] on the earth.
60.pickthall: And had We willed We could have set among you angels to be viceroys in the earth.
60.yusuf_ali: And if it were Our Will, We could make angels from amongst you, succeeding each other on the earth.
60.shakir: And if We please, We could make among you angels to be successors in the land.
60.muhammad_sarwar: Had We wanted, We could have made the angels as your successors on the earth.
60.mohsin_khan: And if it were Our Will, We would have [destroyed you (mankind) all, and] made angels to replace you on the earth. [Tafsir At-Tabari, Vol: 25, Page 89].
60.arberry: Had We willed, We would have appointed angels among you to be successors in the earth.

61.sahih_international: And indeed, Jesus will be [a sign for] knowledge of the Hour, so be not in doubt of it, and follow Me. This is a straight path.
61.pickthall: And lo! verily there is knowledge of the Hour. So doubt ye not concerning it, but follow Me. This is the right path.
61.yusuf_ali: And (Jesus) shall be a Sign (for the coming of) the Hour (of Judgment): therefore have no doubt about the (Hour), but follow ye Me: this is a Straight Way.
61.shakir: And most surely it is a knowledge of the hour, therefore have no doubt about it and follow me: this is the right path.
61.muhammad_sarwar: (Muhammad), tell them, "Jesus is a sign of the Hour of Doom. Have no doubt about it and follow me; this is the straight path.
61.mohsin_khan: And he ['Iesa (Jesus), son of Maryam (Mary)] shall be a known sign for (the coming of) the Hour (Day of Resurrection) [i.e. 'Iesa's (Jesus) descent on the earth]. Therefore have no doubt concerning it (i.e. the Day of Resurrection). And follow Me (Allah) (i.e. be obedient to Allah and do what He orders you to do, O mankind)! This is the Straight Path (of Islamic Monotheism, leading to Allah and to His Paradise).
61.arberry: It is knowledge of the Hour; doubt not concerning it, and follow me. This is a straight path.

62.sahih_international: And never let Satan avert you. Indeed, he is to you a clear enemy.
62.pickthall: And let not Satan turn you aside. Lo! he is an open enemy for you.
62.yusuf_ali: Let not the Evil One hinder you: for he is to you an enemy avowed.
62.shakir: And let not the Shaitan prevent you; surely he is your j open enemy.
62.muhammad_sarwar: Let satan not prevent you from the right path. He is your sworn enemy".
62.mohsin_khan: And let not Shaitan (Satan) hinder you (from the right religion, i.e. Islamic Monotheism), Verily, he (Satan) to you is a plain enemy.
62.arberry: Let not Satan bar you; he is for you a manifest foe.

63.sahih_international: And when Jesus brought clear proofs, he said, "I have come to you with wisdom and to make clear to you some of that over which you differ, so fear Allah and obey me.
63.pickthall: When Jesus came with clear proofs (of Allah's Sovereignty), he said: I have come unto you with wisdom, and to make plain some of that concerning which ye differ. So keep your duty to Allah, and obey me.
63.yusuf_ali: When Jesus came with Clear Signs, he said: "Now have I come to you with Wisdom, and in order to make clear to you some of the (points) on which ye dispute: therefore fear Allah and obey me.
63.shakir: And when Isa came with clear arguments he said: I have come to you indeed with wisdom, and that I may make clear to you part of what you differ in; so be careful of (your duty to) Allah and obey me:
63.muhammad_sarwar: When Jesus came with clear proof (in support of his truthfulness), he said, "I have come to you with wisdom to clarify for you some of the matters in which you have disputes. Have fear of God and obey me.
63.mohsin_khan: And when 'Iesa (Jesus) came with (Our) clear Proofs, he said: "I have come to you with Al-Hikmah (Prophethood), and in order to make clear to you some of the (points) in which you differ, therefore fear Allah and obey me,
63.arberry: And when Jesus came with the clear signs he said, 'I have come to you with wisdom, and that I may make clear to you some of that whereon you are at variance; so fear you God and obey you me.

64.sahih_international: Indeed, Allah is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him. This is a straight path."
64.pickthall: Lo! Allah, He is my Lord and your Lord. So worship Him. This is a right path.
64.yusuf_ali: "For Allah, He is my Lord and your Lord: so worship ye Him: this is a Straight Way."
64.shakir: Surely Allah is my Lord and your Lord, therefore serve Him; this is the right path:
64.muhammad_sarwar: God is your Lord and my Lord, so worship Him. This is the right path".
64.mohsin_khan: "Verily, Allah! He is my Lord (God) and your Lord (God). So worship Him (Alone). This is the (only) Straight Path (i.e. Allah's religion of true Islamic Monotheism)."
64.arberry: Assuredly God is my Lord and your Lord; therefore serve Him; this is a straight path.'

65.sahih_international: But the denominations from among them differed [and separated], so woe to those who have wronged from the punishment of a painful Day.
65.pickthall: But the factions among them differed. Then woe unto those who do wrong from the doom of a painful day.
65.yusuf_ali: But sects from among themselves fell into disagreement: then woe to the wrong-doers, from the Penalty of a Grievous Day!
65.shakir: But parties from among them differed, so woe to those who were unjust because of the chastisement of a painful day.
65.muhammad_sarwar: But certain groups created differences among themselves. Woe to the unjust. They will face a painful torment.
65.mohsin_khan: But the sects from among themselves differed. So woe to those who do wrong (by ascribing things to 'Iesa (Jesus) that are not true) from the torment of a painful Day (i.e. the Day of Resurrection)!
65.arberry: But the parties among them fell into variance; so woe unto those who did evil, because of the chastisement of a painful day.

66.sahih_international: Are they waiting except for the Hour to come upon them suddenly while they perceive not?
66.pickthall: Await they aught save the Hour, that it shall come upon them suddenly, when they know not?
66.yusuf_ali: Do they only wait for the Hour - that it should come on them all of a sudden, while they perceive not?
66.shakir: Do they wait for aught but the hour, that it should come! upon them all of a sudden while they do not perceive?
66.muhammad_sarwar: Are they waiting for the Hour of Doom when the torment will suddenly strike them and they will not even realize from where it came?
66.mohsin_khan: Do they only wait for the Hour that it shall come upon them suddenly, while they perceive not?
66.arberry: Are they looking for aught but the Hour, that it shall come upon them suddenly, when they are not aware?

67.sahih_international: Close friends, that Day, will be enemies to each other, except for the righteous
67.pickthall: Friends on that day will be foes one to another, save those who kept their duty (to Allah).
67.yusuf_ali: Friends on that day will be foes, one to another,- except the Righteous.
67.shakir: The friends shall on that day be enemies one to another, except those who guard (against evil).
67.muhammad_sarwar: All intimate friends on that day will become each others enemies except for the pious,
67.mohsin_khan: Friends on that Day will be foes one to another except Al-Muttaqun (pious - see V. 2:2).
67.arberry: Friends on that day shall be foes to one another, but the god-fearing.

68.sahih_international: [To whom Allah will say], "O My servants, no fear will there be concerning you this Day, nor will you grieve,
68.pickthall: O My slaves! For you there is no fear this day, nor is it ye who grieve;
68.yusuf_ali: My devotees! no fear shall be on you that Day, nor shall ye grieve,-
68.shakir: O My servants! there is no fear for you this day, nor shall you grieve.
68.muhammad_sarwar: whom God will tell, "My servants, you need have no fear on this day, nor will you be grieved".
68.mohsin_khan: (It will be said to the true believers of Islamic Monotheism): My worshippers! No fear shall be on you this Day, nor shall you grieve,
68.arberry: 'O My servants, today no fear is on you, neither do you sorrow' --

69.sahih_international: [You] who believed in Our verses and were Muslims.
69.pickthall: (Ye) who believed Our revelations and were self-surrendered,
69.yusuf_ali: (Being) those who have believed in Our Signs and bowed (their wills to Ours) in Islam.
69.shakir: Those who believed in Our communications and were submissive:
69.muhammad_sarwar: Those who have faith in Our revelations and have submitted themselves to Our will,
69.mohsin_khan: (You) who believed in Our Ayat (proofs, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.) and were Muslims (i.e. who submit totally to Allah's Will, and believe in the Oneness of Allah - Islamic Monotheism).
69.arberry: even those who believed in Our signs, and had surrendered themselves

70.sahih_international: Enter Paradise, you and your kinds, delighted."
70.pickthall: Enter the Garden, ye and your wives, to be made glad.
70.yusuf_ali: Enter ye the Garden, ye and your wives, in (beauty and) rejoicing.
70.shakir: Enter the garden, you and your wives; you shall be made happy.
70.muhammad_sarwar: will be told, "Enter Paradise with your spouses in delight.
70.mohsin_khan: Enter Paradise, you and your wives, in happiness.
70.arberry: 'Enter Paradise, you and your wives, walking with joy!'

71.sahih_international: Circulated among them will be plates and vessels of gold. And therein is whatever the souls desire and [what] delights the eyes, and you will abide therein eternally.
71.pickthall: Therein are brought round for them trays of gold and goblets, and therein is all that souls desire and eyes find sweet. And ye are immortal therein.
71.yusuf_ali: To them will be passed round, dishes and goblets of gold: there will be there all that the souls could desire, all that their eyes could delight in: and ye shall abide therein (for eye).
71.shakir: There shall be sent round to them golden bowls and drinking-cups and therein shall be what their souls yearn after and (wherein) the eyes shall delight, and you shall abide therein.
71.muhammad_sarwar: Golden dishes and cups will be passed among them. All that the souls may desire and that may delight their eyes will be available therein. You will live therein forever.
71.mohsin_khan: Trays of gold and cups will be passed round them, (there will be) therein all that the one's inner-selves could desire, all that the eyes could delight in, and you will abide therein forever.
71.arberry: There shall be passed around them platters of gold, and cups, therein being whatever the souls desire, and the eyes delight in. 'And therein, you shall dwell forever.

72.sahih_international: And that is Paradise which you are made to inherit for what you used to do.
72.pickthall: This is the Garden which ye are made to inherit because of what ye used to do.
72.yusuf_ali: Such will be the Garden of which ye are made heirs for your (good) deeds (in life).
72.shakir: And this is the garden which you are given as an inheritance on account of what you did.
72.muhammad_sarwar: This is the Paradise which you have received as your inheritance by virtue of what you have done.
72.mohsin_khan: This is the Paradise which you have been made to inherit because of your deeds which you used to do (in the life of the world).
72.arberry: This is the Paradise that you have been given for an inheritance for the things that you were doing.

73.sahih_international: For you therein is much fruit from which you will eat.
73.pickthall: Therein for you is fruit in plenty whence to eat.
73.yusuf_ali: Ye shall have therein abundance of fruit, from which ye shall have satisfaction.
73.shakir: For you therein are many fruits of which you shall eat.
73.muhammad_sarwar: You will have abundant fruits therein to consume".
73.mohsin_khan: Therein for you will be fruits in plenty, of which you will eat (as you desire).
73.arberry: Therein you have abundant fruits, whereof you may eat.'

74.sahih_international: Indeed, the criminals will be in the punishment of Hell, abiding eternally.
74.pickthall: Lo! the guilty are immortal in hell's torment.
74.yusuf_ali: The sinners will be in the Punishment of Hell, to dwell therein (for aye):
74.shakir: Surely the guilty shall abide in the chastisement of hell.
74.muhammad_sarwar: The criminals will live forever in the torment of hell. Their torment will not be relieved and they will despair of escaping.
74.mohsin_khan: Verily, the Mujrimun (criminals, sinners, disbelievers, etc.) will be in the torment of Hell to abide therein forever.
74.arberry: But the evildoers dwell forever in the chastisement of Gehenna

75.sahih_international: It will not be allowed to subside for them, and they, therein, are in despair.
75.pickthall: It is not relaxed for them, and they despair therein.
75.yusuf_ali: Nowise will the (Punishment) be lightened for them, and in despair will they be there overwhelmed.
75.shakir: It shall not be abated from them and they shall therein be despairing.
75.muhammad_sarwar: We had not done any injustice to them but they had wronged themselves.
75.mohsin_khan: (The torment) will not be lightened for them, and they will be plunged into destruction with deep regrets, sorrows and in despair therein.
75.arberry: that is not abated for them and therein they are sore confounded.

76.sahih_international: And We did not wrong them, but it was they who were the wrongdoers.
76.pickthall: We wronged them not, but they it was who did the wrong.
76.yusuf_ali: Nowise shall We be unjust to them: but it is they who have been unjust themselves.
76.shakir: And We are not unjust to them, but they themselves were unjust.
76.muhammad_sarwar: They will cry out, "Guard, let your Lord destroy us".
76.mohsin_khan: We wronged them not, but they were the Zalimun (polytheists, wrong-doers, etc.).
76.arberry: We never wronged them, but they themselves did the wrong.

77.sahih_international: And they will call, "O Malik, let your Lord put an end to us!" He will say, "Indeed, you will remain."
77.pickthall: And they cry: O master! Let thy Lord make an end of us. He saith: Lo! here ye must remain.
77.yusuf_ali: They will cry: "O Malik! would that thy Lord put an end to us!" He will say, "Nay, but ye shall abide!"
77.shakir: And they shall call out: O Malik! let your Lord make an end of us. He shall say: Surely you shall tarry.
77.muhammad_sarwar: The angelic guard will say, "You will have to stay.
77.mohsin_khan: And they will cry: "O Malik (Keeper of Hell)! Let your Lord make an end of us." He will say: "Verily you shall abide forever."

78.sahih_international: We had certainly brought you the truth, but most of you, to the truth, were averse.
78.pickthall: We verily brought the Truth unto you, but ye were, most of you, averse to the Truth.
78.yusuf_ali: Verily We have brought the Truth to you: but most of you have a hatred for Truth.
78.shakir: Certainly We have brought you the truth, but most of you are averse to the truth.
78.muhammad_sarwar: We brought you the truth but most of you disliked it".
78.mohsin_khan: Indeed We have brought the truth (Muhammad SAW with the Quran), to you, but most of you have a hatred for the truth.
78.arberry: 'We brought you the truth, but most of you were averse to the truth.'

79.sahih_international: Or have they devised [some] affair? But indeed, We are devising [a plan].
79.pickthall: Or do they determine any thing (against the Prophet)? Lo! We (also) are determining.
79.yusuf_ali: What! have they settled some plan (among themselves)? But it is We Who settle things.
79.shakir: Or have they settled an affair? Then surely We are the settlers.
79.muhammad_sarwar: If the disbelievers persist in their disbelief, We shall also persist in punishing them.
79.mohsin_khan: Or have they plotted some plan? Then We too are planning.
79.arberry: Or have they contrived some matter? We too are contriving.

80.sahih_international: Or do they think that We hear not their secrets and their private conversations? Yes, [We do], and Our messengers are with them recording.
80.pickthall: Or deem they that We cannot hear their secret thoughts and private confidences? Nay, but Our envoys, present with them, do record.
80.yusuf_ali: Or do they think that We hear not their secrets and their private counsels? Indeed (We do), and Our messengers are by them, to record.
80.shakir: Or do they think that We do not hear what they conceal and their secret discourses? Aye! and Our apostles with them write down.
80.muhammad_sarwar: Do they think that We do not hear their secrets and whispers? We certainly can hear them and Our Messengers record it all.
80.mohsin_khan: Or do they think that We hear not their secrets and their private counsel? (Yes We do) and Our Messengers (appointed angels in charge of mankind) are by them, to record.
80.arberry: Or do they think We hear not their secret and what they conspire together? Yes indeed, and Our messengers are present with them writing it down.

81.sahih_international: Say, [O Muhammad], "If the Most Merciful had a son, then I would be the first of [his] worshippers."
81.pickthall: Say (O Muhammad): If the Beneficent One hath a son, then, I shall be first among the worshippers. (But there is no son).
81.yusuf_ali: Say: "If (Allah) Most Gracious had a son, I would be the first to worship."
81.shakir: Say: If the Beneficent Allah has a son, I am the foremost of those who serve.
81.muhammad_sarwar: (Muhammad), say, "Had the Beneficent God really had a son, I would certainly have been the first one to worship him.
81.mohsin_khan: Say (O Muhammad SAW): "If the Most Beneficent (Allah) had a son (or children as you pretend), then I am the first of Allah's worshippers [who deny and refute this claim of yours (and the first to believe in Allah Alone and testify that He has no children)]." [Tafsir At-Tabari].
81.arberry: Say: 'If the All-merciful has a son, then I am the first to serve him.

82.sahih_international: Exalted is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, Lord of the Throne, above what they describe.
82.pickthall: Glorified be the Lord of the heavens and the earth, the Lord of the Throne, from that which they ascribe (unto Him)!
82.yusuf_ali: Glory to the Lord of the heavens and the earth, the Lord of the Throne (of Authority)! (He is free) from the things they attribute (to him)!
82.shakir: Glory to the Lord of the heavens and the earth, the Lord of power, from what they describe.
82.muhammad_sarwar: The Lord of the heavens and the earth and the Throne is too glorious to be described in the way they describe Him.
82.mohsin_khan: Glorified be the Lord of the heavens and the earth, the Lord of the Throne! Exalted be He from all that they ascribe (to Him).
82.arberry: Glory be to the Lord of the heavens and the earth, the Lord of the Throne, above that they describe.'

83.sahih_international: So leave them to converse vainly and amuse themselves until they meet their Day which they are promised.
83.pickthall: So let them flounder (in their talk) and play until they meet the Day which they are promised.
83.yusuf_ali: So leave them to babble and play (with vanities) until they meet that Day of theirs, which they have been promised.
83.shakir: So leave them plunging into false discourses and sporting until they meet their day which they are threatened with.
83.muhammad_sarwar: Leave them (to indulge) in their desires and play around until they face that day which has been promised to them.
83.mohsin_khan: So leave them (alone) to speak nonsense and play until they meet the Day of theirs, which they have been promised.
83.arberry: Then leave them alone to plunge and play, until they encounter that day of theirs which they are promised.

84.sahih_international: And it is Allah who is [the only] deity in the heaven, and on the earth [the only] deity. And He is the Wise, the Knowing.
84.pickthall: And He it is Who in the heaven is Allah, and in the earth Allah. He is the Wise, the Knower.
84.yusuf_ali: It is He Who is Allah in heaven and Allah on earth; and He is full of Wisdom and Knowledge.
84.shakir: And He it is Who is Allah in the heavens and Allah in the earth; and He is the Wise, the Knowing.
84.muhammad_sarwar: It is God who is the Lord of the heavens and is the Lord on earth. He is All-wise and All-knowing.
84.mohsin_khan: It is He (Allah) Who is the only Ilah (God to be worshipped) in the heaven and the only Ilah (God to be worshipped) on the earth. And He is the All-Wise, the All-Knower.
84.arberry: And it is He who in heaven is God and in earth is God; He is the All-wise, the All-knowing.

85.sahih_international: And blessed is He to whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them and with whom is knowledge of the Hour and to whom you will be returned.
85.pickthall: And blessed be He unto Whom belongeth the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, and with Whom is knowledge of the Hour, and unto Whom ye will be returned.
85.yusuf_ali: And blessed is He to Whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth, and all between them: with Him is the Knowledge of the Hour (of Judgment): and to Him shall ye be brought back.
85.shakir: And blessed is He Whose is the kingdom of the heavens and the earth and what is between them, and with Him is the knowledge of the hour, and to Him shall you be brought back.
85.muhammad_sarwar: Blessed is He to whom belongs the heavens, the earth and all that is between them and who has the knowledge of the Hour of Doom. To Him you will all return.
85.mohsin_khan: And blessed be He to Whom belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth, and all that is between them, and with Whom is the knowledge of the Hour, and to Whom you (all) will be returned.
85.arberry: Glory be to Him, to whom belongs the Kingdom of the heavens and the earth and all that between them is; with Him is the knowledge of the Hour, and to Him you shall be returned.

86.sahih_international: And those they invoke besides Him do not possess [power of] intercession; but only those who testify to the truth [can benefit], and they know.
86.pickthall: And those unto whom they cry instead of Him possess no power of intercession, saving him who beareth witness unto the Truth knowingly.
86.yusuf_ali: And those whom they invoke besides Allah have no power of intercession;- only he who bears witness to the Truth, and they know (him).
86.shakir: And those whom they call upon besides Him have no authority for intercession, but he who bears witness of the truth and they know (him).
86.muhammad_sarwar: Those whom they worship besides God are not able to intercede, except for those among them who believe in the Truth (God) and who know whom to intercede for.
86.mohsin_khan: And those whom they invoke instead of Him have no power of intercession; except those who bear witness to the truth (i.e. believed in the Oneness of Allah, and obeyed His Orders), and they know (the facts about the Oneness of Allah).
86.arberry: Those they call upon, apart from Him, have no power of intercession, save such as have testified to the truth, and that knowingly.

87.sahih_international: And if you asked them who created them, they would surely say, "Allah." So how are they deluded?
87.pickthall: And if thou ask them who created them, they will surely say: Allah. How then are they turned away?
87.yusuf_ali: If thou ask them, who created them, they will certainly say, Allah: How then are they deluded away (from the Truth)?
87.shakir: And if you should ask them who created them, they would certainly say: Allah. Whence are they then turned back?
87.muhammad_sarwar: (Muhammad), if you ask them, "Who had created the idols?" They will certainly say, "God has created them." Why do you then turn away from God?
87.mohsin_khan: And if you ask them who created them, they will surely say: "Allah". How then are they turned away (from the worship of Allah, Who created them)?
87.arberry: If thou askest them, 'Who created you?' they will say, 'God.' How then are they perverted?

88.sahih_international: And [Allah acknowledges] his saying, "O my Lord, indeed these are a people who do not believe."
88.pickthall: And he saith: O my Lord! Lo! these are a folk who believe not.
88.yusuf_ali: (Allah has knowledge) of the (Prophet's) cry, "O my Lord! Truly these are people who will not believe!"
88.shakir: Consider his cry: O my Lord! surely they are a people who do not believe.
88.muhammad_sarwar: (God has knowledge of Muhammad's words when he complains to Him), "My Lord, these, my people, do not believe".
88.mohsin_khan: (Allah has knowledge) of (Prophet Muhammad's) saying: "O my Lord! Verily, these are a people who believe not!"
88.arberry: And for his saying, 'My Lord, surely these are a people who believe not' --

89.sahih_international: So turn aside from them and say, "Peace." But they are going to know.
89.pickthall: Then bear with them (O Muhammad) and say: Peace. But they will come to know.
89.yusuf_ali: But turn away from them, and say "Peace!" But soon shall they know!
89.shakir: So turn away from them and say, Peace, for they shall soon come to know.
89.muhammad_sarwar: We have told him, "Ignore them and say to them 'farewell'. They will soon know the consequences of their deeds
89.mohsin_khan: So turn away from them (O Muhammad SAW), and say: Salam (peace)! But they will come to know.
89.arberry: yet pardon them, and say, 'Peace!' Soon they will know.
